daemon.startup:
*Telegram Interactive Daemon Started*

Active Workspace: `{workspace}`
AI Agent: `{agent}`

Send any prompt or `/projects` to start.
daemon.unauthorized: *Unauthorized:* This bot is configured for personal use only.
daemon.help:
*Welcome to Telegram Interactive Agent Bridge!*

Active Project: `{project}`
Path: `{path}`
AI Agent: `{agent}`

*Available Commands:*
• `/projects` - Browse & switch projects with buttons
• `/cd <path/name>` - Switch active project directory directly
• `/ls [path]` - List files & folders in active directory
• `/dirs` - View & manage workspace root folders (`/add_dir`)
• `/language` - Change bot and notification language
• `/status` - Current project & task status
• `/stop` - Cancel running task
• `/help` - Show this message

*To execute*: Simply type any prompt or task, and it will run inside the active project!
daemon.task_already_running:
*A task is already running!*

You can abort it by sending `/stop`.
daemon.switched_workspace:
*Active Workspace Switched!*

Project: *{name}*{branch}
Path: `{path}`

Next prompts will be executed in this workspace.
daemon.task_starting:
*Starting Task Execution...*

Project: `{project}`
Prompt: _"{prompt}"_
Agent: `{agent}`

_Send `/stop` to cancel anytime._
daemon.spawn_failed_help: _Make sure `{agent}` is installed and available in PATH, or specify AI_AGENT_CLI in .env._
daemon.command_not_found_help:
_The AI agent command `{cmd}` was not found on your system._

To resolve this:
1. Check if `{cmd}` is installed (e.g. `agy`, `claude`, `gemini`).
2. Or update `AI_AGENT_CLI` in your `.env` file (e.g. `AI_AGENT_CLI=agy`).
3. Restart the background service: `npm run service:restart`.
daemon.cd_current_workspace:
*Current Active Project:*
`{path}`

*To change workspace:*
• Send: `/cd <path>` (e.g. `/cd ~/workspace/my-project`)
• Or by name: `/cd <project_name>` (e.g. `/cd telegram-notifier`)
• Or choose with buttons: `/projects`
daemon.cd_not_found:
*Directory or project not found:* `{path}`

Check the path or send `/projects` to browse available projects.
